label: early original-phase step (t=3-4) in sequences starting with p, esp. after j / on o ("p ? j o")
explanation: Sparse prefix-pattern feature. 99.6% of mass is in the original phase, almost all at t=3 (71%) or t=4 (25%); it never fires in the copy phase and almost never at the delimiter (9 tiny activations). It is strongly gated by the first token being p (88% of mass, 25x lift). Within those sequences it peaks on the specific prefix "p ? j o": input o right after j at t=3 gives the top activations (about 0.65-1.0 of max), with p 0 j o the strongest. Other p-initial prefixes with j or 0 at positions 1-2 give weaker activations (about 0.05-0.3). Magnitude rises with prev_tok=j, in_tok=o, and a 0 at position 1. Low-quartile activations include non-p sequences such as j j o and a o j o. Predicate: first_tok=p, t in 3..4, and (prev_tok=j or in_tok=o). Dev F1 0.50, mass recall 0.77. Precision is limited because many p-initial t=3/4 steps with j/o stay silent. The exact token conjunction is diffuse; dropping the j/o condition reaches 0.86 mass recall but only 3% precision.
